tools.name: flagsmith_list_organisations
tools.description: List the organisations this API token can access. Good first call to find the organisation scope. Management API: GET /api/v1/organisations/.

tools.name: flagsmith_list_projects
tools.description: List the projects in the organisations this token can access, with their settings. Management API: GET /api/v1/projects/.

tools.name: flagsmith_get_project
tools.description: Get one project's settings (name, organisation, migration status, edge identities). Management API: GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/.

tools.name: flagsmith_list_environments
tools.description: List environments (for example Development, Staging, Production), optionally for one project. Each item has an api_key you pass to the other environment tools. Management API: GET /api/v1/environments/.

tools.name: flagsmith_get_environment
tools.description: Get one environment's settings and its project, by environment API key. Management API: GET /api/v1/environments/{api_key}/.

tools.name: flagsmith_list_features
tools.description: List the feature flags in one project, with type, default state and tags. Use search to filter by name. Management API: GET /api/v1/projects/{project_pk}/features/.

tools.name: flagsmith_get_feature
tools.description: Get one feature flag: its name, type, default value, description and tags. Management API: GET /api/v1/projects/{project_pk}/features/{id}/.

tools.name: flagsmith_list_feature_states
tools.description: List the on/off state and value of each flag in one environment. Filter by feature id or feature name. Each item has an id you can pass to flagsmith_set_feature_state_enabled. Management API: GET /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/featurestates/.

tools.name: flagsmith_list_segments
tools.description: List the segments (rule-based groups of identities) in one project. Use q to search by name. Management API: GET /api/v1/projects/{project_pk}/segments/.

tools.name: flagsmith_get_segment
tools.description: Get one segment with its rules, description and membership counts. Management API: GET /api/v1/projects/{project_pk}/segments/{id}/.

tools.name: flagsmith_list_identities
tools.description: List the identities (end users or devices with traits) known to one environment. Management API: GET /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/identities/.

tools.name: flagsmith_list_audit_log
tools.description: List the audit log of one project: who changed which flag, segment or setting, and when. Management API: GET /api/v1/projects/{project_pk}/audit/.

tools.name: flagsmith_set_feature_state_enabled
tools.description: Set a flag on or off in one environment. This changes live behaviour for every SDK that reads that environment, so check the environment first (use Production with care). Use the id from flagsmith_list_feature_states. Management API: PATCH /api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/featurestates/{id
